mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates consistently across monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise above their respective thresholds, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects sustained manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY rate exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% month-over-month and unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls by more than 0.1 percentage points, it indicates a rapidly strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both PAYEMS growth and UNRATE fall meet their thresholds, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, operating consistently across all economic regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 900.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 900.0 thousand units, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
